greeting.text: Tch. Another one. Zora Ideale. Don't expect a handshake. I might leave a trap in it.
You staring at the straps? Yeah, they're real. So's my temper. Zora Ideale, Black Bulls. What do you want?
Hah! You don't look like a noble. That's a good start. I'm Zora.
You took out Heath Grice? Not bad. Don't get a big head. Zora Ideale. Come to see what a real trap looks like?
You've been in the dungeon long enough to learn how things bite. Good. Zora. Don't step on anything shiny.

hint.text: Rule one of the dungeon: the floor lies to you. A pitfall tile looks exactly like the tiles around it, and if the floor is suspiciously clean, somebody wanted you to walk on it.
Some rooms have a glyph that eats your light. Torches die, lanterns die, and you can't place new ones nearby. Don't plant a torch near one. Carry your light out the other side.
The Eye of the Midnight Sun, hah. Terrorists with relics and rituals who think nobody's watching. Heath Grice even died to hide the plan. Who does that?
Past the thirtieth floor, the Eye's elite wait with their third eyes open. Fun to avoid, anyway. Learn their patterns, then set a trap.
Royal siblings who made deals with devils and took a kingdom. Sounds like nobles. Dante, Vanica, Zenon. I'd love to rig a surprise for each.
Lucius. A Wizard King who turned out to be a Zogratis. Of course. Every time you trust somebody with a title...
Seven sinners from nowhere. No titles, no nobles, no paperwork. I might actually like them. Don't tell them.
A whole city of adventurers working for gods. No kings. Hah. I'd retire there.
Twenty fights. Not bad for someone who isn't a noble. Don't tell me your last name.
Ash Bullets blind what they hit, and Ash Cloud hides you and blinds everything near. Ash is coward's magic, which is why it works.
Revelation of the Cowardly: for thirty seconds, the next three jerks who hit you set off an ash trap. It only opens for my grimoire. Hah. Pay for your own tricks.
Ash Absorbing Formation is a ring of ash that drinks the mana of every enemy inside for eight seconds and pours it into you. Use it on a boss mid-cast. He'll hate it.
Puzzle rooms: four sigils, four colors, and a stone that states the riddle. Press them in order. Press them in the wrong order and it locks you out for a while. Don't guess.
Mars is down? Crystal brain. Fine. He thought he was pretty. Hah.
Zenon, space and bone. Cute. You beat him, so I guess you're allowed to be proud.
Lucius is gone. Good. A king who isn't a king is the worst kind.
Vetto's down? Shame. I'd planned a trap for him. A big one. The kind with a lid.
I hate nobles. Not all of them. Just most of them. Okay, nearly all of them. Noelle's all right.
Traps are honest. Nobody expects a trap to be nice. That's more than I can say for kings.
I pranked Luck once. He liked it. Now he does it back. This is why I can't have nice things.
The straps? Don't ask. It's an old story, and it has a bad ending. For somebody else.
I'm here for justice, kid. And pranks. Mostly pranks.
If a room feels empty and quiet, don't relax. That's usually the trap. Or the boss. Or both.
Wandering bosses walk the rooms like landlords. If you hear heavy footsteps, check your exits before you check your hair.

farewell.text: Tch. Don't die stupidly. Die for something good, if you have to.
Go on, get lost. Watch the floor.
Hah. Come back and tell me what you stepped on.
